LanguageData.Phinix_store_inactive: This package is unavailable for dependency planning.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_preview: Browse an HTTPS repository, review dependencies, and install verified new ZIP packages. Enable them in RimWorld and restart. Offline caches authorize browsing only.

LanguageData.Phinix_store_noInstall: Installation requires confirmation and fresh online checks. Existing packages are never overwritten.

LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_Failed: Operation failed. The previous valid index remains available.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_offline: Offline cache: browsing and plan preview only
LanguageData.Phinix_store_stale: Previous or expired browsing cache. Withdrawal status needs an online refresh; installation is unavailable.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_CheckingPackages: Downloading and checking the frozen package plan…
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_PayloadsVerified: All new ZIP packages passed static checks. Nothing installed.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_install: Install new packages in this plan
LanguageData.Phinix_store_installConfirm: Install the following packages? Files will be written to local Mods after online and payload checks. Nothing is enabled automatically; enable the mods and restart RimWorld afterwards.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_managedRefresh: Refresh installed packages / recover unfinished operations
LanguageData.Phinix_store_uninstallConfirm: Remove this store-owned package? First disable it in RimWorld’s Mods list and restart if its DLL has been loaded. Dependent packages and modified files block deletion. Saves and plugin settings are preserved.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_Installing: Downloading and staging packages; checking the online index again…

LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_Managing: Checking owned packages and recovering unfinished operations…
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_Uninstalled: Package uninstalled. Restart RimWorld to refresh its mod list. Saves and settings were preserved.

LanguageData.Phinix_store2_state_Canceled: Task canceled. An installation with a durable commit decision will finish.

LanguageData.Phinix_store2_optionalPluginsNoticeTitle: Red packets and Talent trade are now separate plugins
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_optionalPluginsNotice:
This update no longer bundles Red packets and Talent trade with the main mod. To keep using them, open Plugin store and install the plugins separately, then restart the game.
This change does not delete your plugin settings or save files. If you already installed the standalone plugins, no reinstall is needed. The store offers Phinix-managed DLL plugins; Steam Workshop mods are subscribed to separately.
If GitHub is unreachable, click "GitHub direct" in the store and try "CF acceleration".
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_disabledModulesRecovery: All modules are disabled in Phinix settings. Open Extensions and enable the saved module entries before retrying installation.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_disabledPackageRecovery: The installed package is disabled or pending removal. Check Extensions → Packages and restart to complete removal before reinstalling.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_assemblyConflictRecovery: An assembly identity is still occupied. Restart after uninstalling, then retry; check for another copy if the conflict remains.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_pathTooLongFriendly: Plugin paths are too long. Use a shorter game data folder path and try again.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_storageFriendly: Could not write plugin files. Check free disk space and folder permissions, then try again.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_recoveryFriendly: An interrupted plugin operation requires recovery. Restart the game to recover it; if it persists, share the error details and log.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_environmentFriendly: The plugin environment is not ready. Open error details and share the log if refreshing or restarting does not help.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_environmentChangedFriendly: The plugin environment changed. Restart the game, refresh the store and review the installation again.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_ownershipFriendly: Managed plugin records or file ownership cannot be confirmed. Keep existing files and share error details and the log.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_dependencyFriendly: A required dependency is missing, disabled or incompatible. Check related extensions and review the installation again.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_reviewFriendly: The catalog, plan or local state has changed. Refresh the store online and review the action again.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_busyFriendly: Another store operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish or cancel it before retrying.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_unavailableFriendly: This listing is unavailable for installation or already installed. Refresh the store and check Extensions.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_contentFriendly: Plugin metadata or files failed validation. Refresh the store and retry; if it persists, share error details and the log.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_inputFriendly: An address, local path or source ID is invalid. Check store settings and the selected local file.
